study.title: Modulation of entorhinal cortex–hippocampus connectivity and recognition memory following electroacupuncture on 3×Tg-AD model: Evidence from multimodal MRI and electrophysiological recordings
study.study_design: Randomized controlled animal study using 3×Tg-AD transgenic mice and age-matched wildtype controls; four groups: EA-treated, Non-acupoint EA-treated, untreated 3×Tg-AD, wildtype control
study.randomization: Homozygous 3×Tg-AD mice were randomly assigned to three groups by the random digital table
study.blinding: Data analysis was performed by an experimenter blind to group information
study.population: Five months 3×Tg-AD mice and age-matched littermate wildtype-controls
study.inclusion_criteria: Five months 3×Tg-AD transgenic mice expressing mutant human APPSwe, human PS1 (M146V) and mutant tau (P301L); offspring genotyped by PCR analysis using tail DNA to confirm the presence of mutant genes; age-matched littermate wildtype-controls

conditions.dose_or_intensity_label: 1 mA, 1/20 Hz, disperse-dense-mode, 30 min daily, 5 consecutive days weekly, 4 weeks

conditions.tissue_level_reasoning: The description explicitly states insertion to approximately 2–3 mm depth, which falls within the superficial 1–5 mm range engaging cutaneous fibers only, not reaching muscle or fascia. This is a needle that does penetrate the skin but only superficially.

conditions.scan_context: Resting-state fMRI and DTI acquisition under isoflurane anesthesia
Ex vivo whole-cell voltage-clamp recording of hippocampal CA1

interventions.penetration_exact: inserted approximately 2–3 mm depth in each site
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: Before stimulation was initiated, the torso of the mice was fixed to restrict excessive mobility

neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: T2-weighted images (T2WI) using TurboRARE sequence; rs-fMRI using echo-planar imaging (EPI) sequence; DTI using standard gradient-echo echo planar imaging sequence
neuroimaging_methods.TR_exact: T2WI: 4,200 ms; rs-fMRI: 2,000 ms; DTI: 12,000 ms
neuroimaging_methods.TE_exact: T2WI: 35 ms; rs-fMRI: 10.28 ms; DTI: 33 ms
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: T2WI: FOV=20×20 mm, image size=256×256, slice thickness=0.5 mm; rs-fMRI: FOV=20×20 mm, image size=64×64, slice thickness=0.5 mm; DTI: FOV=20 mm×20 mm, image size=96×96, slice thickness=0.5 mm
neuroimaging_methods.scan_duration_exact: rs-fMRI: repetitions=200; DTI: not explicitly stated
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM8) and the Data Processing Assistant for Resting-State fMRI (DPARSF) software package
neuroimaging_methods.analysis_software_exact: SPM8, DPARSF, TrackVis image processing software (fiber tracking using FACT algorithm), MRIcron software (DICOM to NIfTI conversion)
neuroimaging_methods.normalization_template_exact: mouse standard brain template registered to b0 image (DTI); spatial standardization performed (rs-fMRI; template not named explicitly)
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: Gaussian kernel with a 1.5× voxel size Full Width of Half Maximum (FWHM)
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: Where the head movement translation is greater than 1.5 mm or the rotation angle exceeds 1.5°, the data is rejected
neuroimaging_methods.filtering_exact: 0.01–0.08 Hz frequency band is used to perform time-space mean filtering on the data; images were removed linear trend
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: DTI fiber tracking (number of nerve fiber connections)
statistical_thresholds_exact: one-way ANOVA (FC and DTI fiber count among groups)
Pearson linear regression analysis (correlations with ORT data)

extraction_notes.note: No MNI or Talairach coordinates are reported for any ReHo brain region. All neuroimaging regional results are from figures only (Figure 3A, 3B, 3C). Exact peak coordinates, cluster sizes, and voxel-level statistics are not reported in text or tables.

The coordinate space for the mouse brain atlas is not explicitly named (e.g., Paxinos atlas is mentioned for DTI ROI definition but not for fMRI space). No MNI/Talairach space is applicable; all results are in a mouse-specific space.

Exact mean ± SEM values for behavioral outcomes (OFT, NORT recognition indices) and electrophysiological outcomes (sEPSC amplitude, frequency) are not provided in the text; they appear only in figures (Figures 1B, 1C, 2A–D, 4B, 4C) which cannot be precisely read from the PDF description.

Exact mean ± SEM values for functional connectivity strength between hippocampus and entorhinal cortex (Figure 6B) and for DTI fiber count between hippocampus and entorhinal cortex (Figure 7B) are not reported numerically in the text.
Sensory/interoceptive responses (deqi, pain, etc.) were not assessed or reported in this animal study. Mice were subjects; no subjective sensation reporting is possible or attempted.
Expectancy, blinding success, credibility, and allocation guessing measures are not applicable to an animal study and were not assessed.
Adverse events are not reported in this animal study.

The paper states in the abstract 'hypo-connected between the hippocampus and EC with EA-treatment' but the results section clearly states 'There was significantly increased connectivity with the EA-treatment.' The abstract wording appears to describe a relative reduction compared to wildtype (i.e., EA group is still lower than WT) rather than a hypo-connection relative to untreated AD. The full data interpretation indicates EA-treatment increased FC relative to untreated 3×Tg-AD.

The exact electrical stimulation parameters for the Non-EA group are not explicitly stated (only the EA group parameters are given: 1 mA, 1/20 Hz). It is implied the same stimulator settings were used but this is not confirmed.
The post hoc test used (Turkey-Kramer HSD vs Dunnett's T3) depends on variance homogeneity but the paper does not specify which post hoc test was applied to each outcome.

The specific normalization/registration template used for rs-fMRI spatial standardization of mouse brain data is not named in the methods. Only 'Spatial standardization' is mentioned as a preprocessing step.
Multiple comparison correction for ReHo whole-brain voxel-wise analysis is not reported. Only P = 0.005 threshold is stated.

ReHo brain region results (Figure 3A, 3B, 3C) are presented as brain slice images with color bars. No coordinate tables or numerical summary tables are provided for these results. Region names are extracted from figure labels and text descriptions only.

The paper abbreviates some figure captions with region codes (EC, HIP, Pir, CPu, OC, IC, SC, SN, AI) but these match the region names used in text. AI (agranular insular cortex) appears in Figure 3A caption but is not explicitly named in the results text; it may correspond to the insular cortex.
PMID is not reported in the paper. The DOI is 10.3389/fnins.2022.968767.
Supplementary Figures 1A and 1B referenced for acupoint and non-acupoint locations are not included in the PDF provided. The relevant information was partially described in the main text.
